ranked_hypotheses.transform: Couples (1) a 2-m shallow temperature probe lateral thermal-wall gradient |grad T_2m| (sigma=400 m) + survey-deconfounded F2mDAB plume + 726 paleo-sinter/travertine/tufa vents + 300 m upslope-advected quartz/chalcedony geothermometer excess + MT 2000m clay-cap flank gradient + GeoDAWN K/eTh & eU/eTh alteration, (2) bi-harmonic basement plate flexure |nabla^4 z_b| co-activated with Laplace vertical gravity curvature g_zz = -(d_x B18 + d_row B11) and Poisson magnetite-destruction residual max(0, alpha*z(g_zz) - z(M_z)), deconfounded for Lahontan/Bonneville shorelines and GeoDAWN block seams, and (3) 1 m LiDAR / 10 m DEM / fluvial chi scarplet chains; fused in E2 via Dual-Regime Noisy-OR with strictly fold-visible inter-component relay bridges (two_host_frame C1!=C2), crack-tip cones, and bend hinges, emitted with Euclidean r=2.8 px disc thinning and h33-2-b2 d>2.0 px collar at 37,654 dots.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Down-gradient lateral thermal outflow plumes in permeable alluvial fans (mitigated by |grad T_2m| thermal-wall gradient and 300 m upslope advection along +grad DEM); Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1270, 1332 m) and Bonneville (1463, 1552 m) wave-cut shoreline benches; unfaulted circular Mesozoic pluton contacts and GeoDAWN survey-block stitch seams; flat-lying conductive playa evaporites.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary surface mapping misses intrabasin accommodation zones, buried stepover relay breaches, and piedmont synthetic splays beneath Holocene fan/playa veneer. Buoyant hydrothermal fluids ascend along these exact unmapped dilated basement fractures, depositing silica sinter/travertine mounds, creating sharp lateral 2-m thermal walls |grad T_2m|, altering magnetite to pyrite along bi-harmonic basement flexure hinges, and nucleating inside stepover relays and fault tips.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: First lane in GEMSDOE86 to compute the lateral thermal-wall gradient |grad T_2m| of the 3,800 GDR-1391 2-m probes coupled with 726 paleo-sinter/tufa vents, bi-harmonic basement plate flexure |nabla^4 z_b|, and Laplace g_zz Poisson magnetite-destruction residuals, and first to pair that hydrothermal-conduit physics with a clean 3-arm ablation separating (E1) pure zero-catalogue blind conduit physics, (E2) fold-fair Noisy-OR coupling with visible relay/tip/bend traps under h33-2-b2's d>2.0 px collar (37,654 dots), and (E3) unpruned d>1.5 px collar at 44,090 dots.
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Low-Moderate (~45 s total runtime on CPU; zero external network fetches beyond already-pinned local mirrors).
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Verified and SHA-256-pinned locally from DOE GDR Submission 1391 (https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391, DOI 10.15121/1881483, CC-BY-4.0), USGS 3DEP (https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program, CC0 1.0), and USGS GeoDAWN (https://doi.org/10.5066/P93LGLVQ).

ranked_hypotheses.name: Split-Window Directional Radon-Gabor Phase-Coherence Across Alluvial Fan Pediments
layers: USGS 3DEP lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (Bands 1, 3, 6, 11) and topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif (Bands 6, 7, 8)

ranked_hypotheses.transform: Multi-wavelength quadrature log-Gabor filter bank (wavelengths 300, 600, 1200 m across 12 azimuths) measuring amplitude-invariant cross-modal Fourier phase congruency cos(phi_scarp - phi_gravmag) across 1 m LiDAR / 10 m DEM scarplets and potential-field horizontal gradients.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Eolian sand-dune trains, braided distributary channels on alluvial fans, and flight-line acquisition corrugations.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Distributed en-echelon fault splays in unconsolidated pediment gravels have sub-meter vertical relief that falls below single-scale slope thresholds, but preserve scale-invariant Fourier phase alignment with underlying basement potential-field steps.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Replaces single-scale Gaussian Hessian eigenvalues and box collinearity filters with multi-frequency quadrature log-Gabor phase congruency.
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Moderate (~180 s for 36 complex 2D FFT convolutions across 3730x3292); deferred behind H86I-1 within the 3-experiment budget.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Available in local SHA-256-pinned USGS 3DEP and competition rasters.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Anisotropic Biot Poromechanics & Fluid-Overpressure Mohr-Coulomb Reactivation Potential
layers: training_features.tif Bands 4, 7, 8 (geodetic strain invariants), Bands 10, 16 (seismicity), Band 14 (heatflow), Band 15 (depth_to_base_surf), Band 17 (cond_surf)
DOE GDR-1391 gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv (geothermquartz_c, geothermchalc_c, geothermcat_c)
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Resolves GPS strain rate tensor onto local potential-field strike theta to compute shear/normal traction ratio tau(theta) / (sigma_n(theta) - alpha_Biot * P_f), where pore-fluid overpressure P_f is estimated from multi-solute chemical geothermometer enthalpy excess and conductive heat flow trapped beneath high-conductance smectite clay caps.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Broad regional GPS strain smoothing kernels (~25 km) and non-tectonic conductive playa brines.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Critically stressed blind faults with low surface slip rates remain unscarped until localized hydrothermal fluid overpressure P_f reduces effective normal stress into the Byerlee failure envelope (Sibson 1994).
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Explicitly projects the 2D geodetic strain tensor onto local geophysical strike and couples Biot pore-pressure reduction from chemical geothermometers.
ranked_hypotheses.cost: Low (~30 s), but coarse ~25 km GPS strain resolution limits standalone 300 m spatial localization compared to H86I-1.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Available in local SHA-256-pinned competition and GDR-1391 datasets.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Full-Tensor 3D Magnetotelluric Impedance Phase-Tensor Skew (beta_MT) & Tipper Induction Vectors
layers: USGS/USArray 3D MT EDI station impedance tensors Z(omega) and geomagnetic transfer functions T(omega) (periods 0.1-1000 s)
training_features.tif Band 17 cond_surf and Band 15 depth_to_base_surf
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Caldwell-Bibby-Brown (2004) galvanic-distortion-invariant MT phase tensor Phi = X^-1 Y skew angle beta_MT = 0.5*atan((Phi_12 - Phi_21)/(Phi_11 + Phi_22)) and Parkinson real induction arrows pointing into steep 3D sub-vertical conductive fault-fluid conduits at 2-8 km depth.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: 1D/2D flat-lying conductive playa evaporites and smectite basin fill (where |beta_MT| ~ 0 deg) vs 3D sub-vertical fault-fluid channels (|beta_MT| > 5 deg).
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Scalar 2000 m conductivity (Band 17) conflates horizontal stratigraphic clay layers with vertical hydrothermal fault conduits; only the full 2x2 complex MT phase tensor skew and vertical magnetic tipper isolate 3D vertical fracture permeability.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Uses full complex impedance phase-tensor skew and tipper vectors rather than scalar Band 17 conductivity.
ranked_hypotheses.cost: NOT_VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_YET: requires fetching raw MT EDI station archives from USGS ScienceBase / IRIS SPUD (sciencebase.gov / ds.iris.edu), which are blocked by the sandbox outbound host allowlist.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: NOT_VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_YET (external host blocked in sandbox; documented per protocol).
